text: Refund policy: a refund is issued to the original card within five days of the return arriving.
We reimburse return postage when the book arrived damaged.
Money-back requests for ebooks are accepted within fourteen days if the file was not downloaded.
A parcel that shows delivered but never arrived is traced with the courier before a replacement is sent.
Package tracking numbers are emailed when the order leaves the warehouse.
Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash.
Preorders are charged when the book ships, not when the order is placed.
Signed editions are final sale and cannot be returned.
To change the shipping address, contact the help desk before the order is packed.
A duplicate charge on one order is reversed by the payments team within two working days.
Return labels are sent by email and are valid for thirty days.
Damaged books can be photographed and reported through the order page.
